title: cli: os init templates ship objects but no app, so the first Console visit shows nothing of the project (the create-objectstack gap, in the other scaffolder)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named site. Found beside #32152 by its card thread (os-dev report 6767372707, out-of-scope finding, class a). #32152 fixes `create-objectstack`'s blank template (PR #32209). `os init` is the other scaffolder and has the same gap.
Business reason: a new user who starts with `os init` opens the Console the banner points to and sees nothing they made, the same first impression #32152 fixes for `npm create objectstack`.
Reader: the next `domain:server` seat that claims it. The fix lands in `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` (its three templates).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `os init template no app console` (101 hits; on point only #32152, which is the create-objectstack half).
reach: `os init`, all three templates.

## What happens

`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` writes `src/objects/*` and no `src/apps`, in all three templates, including the one described as "Full application with objects". A project it creates boots with its objects served over REST and MCP, but no app lists them, so the Console has no route to them.

## Expected

Each template ships a minimal app listing its objects, plus a default list view for each, the same shapes `os g app` / `os g view` write, as #32152 does for `create-objectstack`.

## Implementation note

The generators type the object name out (`objectName: '<ns>_note'`). A template that is renamed per project (as `create-objectstack`'s scaffold rename does, rewriting only `name:` literals) leaves that string dangling. #32209 references the object as `Note.name` for this reason. Do the same here, or teach the rename (`rewrite-identity.ts`) to move `objectName` / `object` literals too, and say which.
